applies_to: Stage D fixed-recipe per-round raw M50 evaluation ONLY
evaluator: sfm_b1_offline_eval.py (executed sliding-window Validity, exact GREEN verifier)

rule.candidates: rounds r >= 1 of the single frozen recipe run
liveness_gate: pooled SR(r) >= pooled SR(r0) - 0.02 on the same M50 CRN bank
objective_order_among_eligible: 2. maximize pooled window Validity (mean of per-trajectory fractions)

four_user_metrics_operationalization.time_to_goal: objective 4; a slower checkpoint is acceptable only if it strictly wins an earlier objective, which is exactly what the lexicographic order encodes

rule.if_no_round_passes_gate: report honestly that the fixed recipe did not produce an eligible improvement; publish the full Pareto frontier over (CR, Validity, clearance, time) for all rounds and do NOT promote a collapsed checkpoint
rule.pareto_reporting: alongside the winner, all non-dominated rounds on (CR down, Validity up, clearance up, time down) are listed in the delivery

prohibitions: no per-gamma or global temperature tuning (temperature fixed 1.0)
no gathering-controller SR or training-loss in selection
no checkpoint selection from the M100 confirmation bank
no recipe or Kazuki changes after reading confirmation
